name: What are the main risks with ground-up construction, and how are they managed?

mainEntity.name: What are the main risks with ground-up construction, and how are they managed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Risks include site surprises, permitting delays, price volatility, and coordination issues; they’re mitigated through early due diligence, contingencies, realistic scheduling, and strong project management. rsvc+2
